facts.note: At the bell striking nine, watches shown at dinner: hers exact, Félix 20 min behind, Girard 4 min behind, the doctor 2 min ahead.
After dinner she worked beside the master in the atelier; when the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
He sent her downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; the regulator was running and he was well.
In the kitchen she compared her watch with Rosa's clock, which was exactly fifteen minutes fast.
Madame's piano began at twelve minutes to eleven and stopped at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
She went straight down to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa from arrival until after the temple struck eleven.

added.quote: He was in his shirtsleeves, bent over the repeater, and he was himself.
added.why: Places the master at his repeater at the moment he sent her down (10:20), which the sheet does not say.

added.quote: He was pleased, and he went back to his bench.
added.why: The master moved back to his bench after the regulator agreed with the bell at ten, so he was moving about the atelier after ten struck.
